Container.Name: Factorio-Server-Manager
Container.Overview: Operate one Factorio dedicated server through a modern web interface with independent profiles, saves, fixed checkpoints, compatible mods and dependencies, stable/experimental/exact game versions, base Factorio or Space Age, world creation, factory-map snapshots, logs, users and safe server controls.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: factorio dedicated server manager mods saves space age
Container.Requires: Persistent manager-data, saves, mods and config paths are required. Internet access is required on first start so the selected official Factorio headless release can be downloaded. The image supports linux/amd64.
Container.Changes: 0.15.1: Added the public Community Applications template and one hierarchical appdata root with separate data, saves, mods and config directories.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Host port used to open the Factorio Server Manager web interface.

Config.Name: Factorio Game Port
Config.Description: UDP port used by Factorio clients to connect to the game server.

Config.Name: Manager Data (required)
Config.Description: Persistent manager database, UI users, configuration, logs, credentials, profiles, checkpoints and map snapshots. Never remove this mapping during an update.

Config.Name: Mods (required)
Config.Description: Persistent downloaded mods, built-in game-mode selection and mod-list.json.

Config.Name: Config (required)
Config.Description: Persistent Factorio server and map configuration.

Config.Name: Initial Factorio Version
Config.Description: Used only for the first installation: latest, stable or an exact version such as 2.1.14. Later UI choices are persisted across container updates.

Config.Name: RCON Password
Config.Description: Optional internal Factorio RCON password. Leave empty to generate and persist a random password automatically.
